answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1531 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the prism. The whisper index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the wander queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. That is 32 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
